_comment: Factory v3 — the candidate specs that survived both walk-forward AND bootstrap PF CI gate (lower bound >= 1.20). These are NOT promoted to paper yet; they're the input to the next decision: do we activate any of them in the post-reset paper window? Per project_2026_05_20 memo the CI lower bound is what real-money sizing should reflect, not the point estimate. Generated 2026-05-22 from factory_v2_bootstrap_20260522.json.

specs.name: donchian_10_breakout
specs._notes: Passes bootstrap on SPY (CI[1.36,3.32]) and DIA (CI[1.26,2.99]). Fails on QQQ/GLD/EFA/EEM/IWM/TLT. Edge is broad-equity short-term momentum continuation.

specs.name: donchian_55_breakout_turtle
specs._notes: Passes bootstrap ONLY on QQQ (CI[1.30,4.66]). Classic Turtle param. QQQ-specific edge — likely captures the tech megacap trending behavior.

specs.name: donchian_55_breakout_gated
specs._notes: Passes bootstrap ONLY on QQQ (CI[1.31,4.94]). Trend-gate variant of donchian_55. Marginal improvement over ungated on QQQ. Pick ONE if activating to avoid double-counting.

specs.name: rsi2_oversold_connors
specs._notes: Passes bootstrap ONLY on GLD (CI[1.29,5.69]). Connors-style RSI(2) + 200-SMA trend filter mean-reversion. Different edge family than donchian — uncorrelated by construction.
